_help: Copy to Assets/Resources/studio_app.json. Every key is empty by default: an empty file starts nothing (no network call, no ad). Fill a section to turn that part on; docs/ADS_UNITY.md says where each value comes from.

pulse._help: Studio Pulse analytics: collector URL (https in store builds) + public write key. Both or nothing.

privacy._help: Shared by the ad providers. attUsageDescription: the iOS tracking prompt text per language (en is required for the prompt). gdprConsent: "", "granted" or "denied" when the game has no consent platform.

levelplay._help: Unity LevelPlay (first choice): app keys from the LevelPlay platform (Apps), ad unit ids (Ad units). tools/ads_onboard.py fills these in.

max._help: AppLovin MAX (used only when levelplay is empty for the platform): SDK key (Account > General > Keys) and ad unit ids. tools/ads_onboard.py --provider max fills the ids in.

appsflyer._help: AppsFlyer MMP (needs the AppsFlyer Unity plug-in 7.x in the project): dev key; iosAppId is the numeric App Store id.

ump._help: Google UMP consent form (EEA / UK) before LevelPlay starts: AdMob app ids (ca-app-pub-...~...). Needs StudioPulseUmpDependencies.xml in Assets and the STUDIO_PULSE_UMP define. Empty: skipped.

pacing._help: Optional limits on top of the game's own (0 = none).
